your_games.title: Kingdom Hearts on Switch 2
your_games.body: Three Kingdom Hearts collections are out now on Switch 2, and HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is also on Switch. A free Re Mind DLC demo is live, and buying Collection I–III or III + Re Mind unlocks the exclusive Long Night Keyblade.

your_games.title: Enshrouded 1.0
your_games.body: Keen Games leaves early access on Thursday 15 Oct on PC and PS5 (Xbox is spring 2027). Sparkworks creator tools land with it, so you can build shared puzzles, dungeons and mini-games — worth a look if you like Valheim-style survival crafting.

your_games.title: Resident Evil on Switch 2
your_games.body: RE2 Deluxe, RE3 and RE4 Gold Edition land digitally on Switch 2 this Friday 16 Oct. Boxed copies follow 29 Jan 2027. Gold Edition includes Separate Ways.

your_games.title: Valor Mortis
your_games.body: Launch trailer is out for the Ghostrunner team's Napoleonic soulslike. It drops tomorrow (13 Oct) on PS5, Xbox Series, Game Pass and Steam, with New Game+ planned for Q4.

your_games.title: Pokémon UNITE
your_games.body: Flareon (All-Rounder) and Jolteon (Speedster) join tomorrow, 13 Oct, free during the Eevee Festival through 1 Dec.

your_games.title: Tomb Raider × The Crew Motorfest
your_games.body: Season 11: Expeditions is live across platforms, and Motorfest is now on Switch 2. The premium Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni'ihau DLC adds Lara Croft (voiced by Alix Wilton Regan), a new island and vehicles; Kauai is free for everyone.

industry.title: Nintendo keeps physical games
industry.body: Nintendo's Latin America VP says there are no plans to ditch physical Switch 2 releases. The company will keep both cartridges and game-key cards as long as players want them — a clear contrast with Sony ending new discs from Jan 2028.

industry.title: PS5 Pro shortage
industry.body: Engadget reports Playfront saying Sony told partners Pro supply constraints will run into 2027. Resale prices are climbing hard ahead of GTA 6 on 19 Nov; Rockstar still has not confirmed a meaningful Pro-only performance bump beyond the Enhanced label.

industry.title: Marvel Tokon Year 1 DLC
industry.body: At EVO France, Arc System Works locked the rest of Year 1: Phoenix Cyclops on 2 Nov, then Jane Foster's Thor (winter 2027), Venom (spring) and Jubilee (summer).

industry.title: ECC: Redline vs Warzone
industry.body: NetEase's free-to-play ECC: Redline reveal has CoD fans calling it a near Warzone clone — some are angry, some are wishlist-curious. No release date yet; Steam wishlist is open. MW4 still lands 23 Oct.
